description: ABS Qualifications and Work, 2022-23 (QAW2223). Survey covering non-school qualifications held by Australians, their relevance to current employment, income levels by qualification, reasons for incomplete study, and qualification attainment among migrants. Released 19 April 2024. Includes comparison data from 2018-19 wave.
